# 1 Chronicles Chapter 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 380r–380v

---

**18:1** And-it-was after this, and-struck [vayyakh] David the-Pelishtim and-subdued-them, and-took Gat and-its-daughters [benoteyha] from-the-hand of-the-Pelishtim.

**18:2** And-he-struck Moav, and-became the-Moavim servants [avadim] to-David, bearers of-tribute [minchah].

**18:3** And-struck David Hadad'ezer king of-Tsovah [toward] Chamat, as-he-went to-establish his-hand [yado] at-the-river Perat [Euphrates].

**18:4** And-captured David from-him a-thousand chariots and-seven thousand horsemen [parashim] and-twenty thousand foot-soldiers [ragli], and-hamstrung [vay'aqer] David all the-chariot [-horses], and-left from-them a-hundred chariots.

**18:5** And-came Aram of-Dammeseq to-help Hadad'ezer king of-Tsovah, and-struck David of-Aram twenty-two thousand men.

**18:6** And-placed David [garrisons] in-Aram of-Dammeseq, and-became Aram servants to-David, bearers of-tribute. And-saved [vayyosha] YHWH David in-all where he-went.

**18:7** And-took David the-shields [shiltey] of-gold that were on the-servants of-Hadad'ezer, and-brought-them to-Yerushalayim.

**18:8** And-from-Tivchat and-from-Kun, cities of-Hadad'ezer, took David very much bronze [nechoshet]; from-it Shelomoh made the-sea of-bronze [yam ha-nechoshet] and-the-pillars and-the-vessels of-bronze.

**18:9** And-heard To'u king of-Chamat that David had-struck all the-army of-Hadad'ezer king of-Tsovah.

**18:10** And-he-sent Hadoram his-son to the-king David, to-inquire of-his-welfare [lish'ol lo leshalom] and-to-bless-him [ulevarekho] because he-fought against-Hadad'ezer and-struck-him — for a-man of-wars [ish milchamot] of-To'u was Hadad'ezer — and-all vessels of-gold and-silver and-bronze.

**18:11** Also these the-king David consecrated [hiqdish] to-YHWH, with the-silver and-the-gold that he-carried from all the-nations — from-Edom, and-from-Moav, and-from-the-sons of-Ammon, and-from-the-Pelishtim, and-from-Amaleq.

**18:12** And-Avshai son of-Tseruyah struck Edom in-the-Valley of-Salt [Gey ha-Melach], eighteen thousand.

**18:13** And-he-placed in-Edom garrisons [netsivim], and-became all Edom servants to-David. And-saved YHWH David in-all where he-went.

**18:14** And-reigned David over all Yisra'el, and-he-was doing justice [mishpat] and-righteousness [tsedaqah] for-all his-people.

**18:15** And-Yo'av son of-Tseruyah [was] over the-army, and-Yehoshafat son of-Achilud [was] recorder [mazkir].

**18:16** And-Tsadoq son of-Achituv and-Avimelekh son of-Evyatar [were] priests [kohanim], and-Shavsha [was] scribe [sofer].

**18:17** And-Benayahu son of-Yehoyada [was] over the-Kereti and-the-Peleti, and-the-sons of-David [were] the-first [ha-rishonim] at-the-hand [beyad] of-the-king.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Gath and its daughters":** Where 2 Samuel 8:1 has the obscure "Metheg-ammah," the Chronicler clarifies: David took Gath and its dependent villages. The Chronicler interprets what Samuel left opaque.

**v.4 — "seven thousand horsemen":** 2 Samuel 8:4 reads "one thousand seven hundred horsemen." The numbers differ — Chronicles consistently inflates military figures, a pattern scholars have long noted.

**v.8 — Tibhath and Cun:** These replace 2 Samuel's "Betah and Berothai." The Chronicler adds that Solomon used this bronze for the temple furnishings — connecting David's wars to the temple project.

**v.12 — "Edom" not "Aram":** 2 Samuel 8:13 reads "Aram" (aleph-resh-mem), while Chronicles has "Edom" (aleph-dalet-mem). The letters resh and dalet are easily confused in Hebrew script. Most scholars regard "Edom" as correct, given the Valley of Salt is in Edomite territory.

**v.17 — "the first at the hand of the king":** 2 Samuel 8:18 says "David's sons were priests" (*kohanim*). The Chronicler changes this to "the first at the hand of the king" — a deliberate revision, since only Aaronic descendants can be priests in the Chronicler's theology.

*— EMET*
